architecture.stage1: RandomForest (500 trees, balanced_subsample) over one-hot encoded seven-locus allele tokens
architecture.stage2: Rule-based Cryptic gate using allele/profile distances and low classical Stage 1 support

distribution.companion_reproducibility_archive: Distributed in the companion Zenodo / Supplementary Data 1 archive (v1.0.0; CC BY 4.0): source_data/train_v2.csv, source_data/test_v2.csv, source_data/nan.mlst, and source_data/allele_sequences_cache/*.json.
distribution.rights_statement: The repository owner is the author of the training data, distance matrices, and derived model, authorized public redistribution of the derived model and distance matrices under MIT terms, and distributes the underlying benchmark tables in the companion Zenodo reproducibility archive.

intended_use: Research classification of C. difficile seven-locus MLST profiles into Clade1-Clade5 or a combined Cryptic category.
limitations: The model does not distinguish individual Cryptic lineages.
It accepts allele identifiers, not genome assemblies or nucleotide sequences.
Unknown allele identifiers use a conservative fallback distance rather than sequence-derived distance.
Stage 1 RandomForest probabilities are not calibrated probabilities of the final prediction.
Clade3 held-out test support is only three sequence types.
This is a research tool and is not validated for clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions.
